posts.title: Hardware security course
posts.description: I recently taught a brand new Hardware security course to roughly 70 master’s students at Paderborn University . Since I pretty much had a free hand in shaping the course and making it what I wanted I made it the hardware security course I missed during my bachelor’s and master’s. posts.title: The goals of artifact evaluation
posts.description: I have participated in artifact evaluation committees since 2021. I have done 5 years of CHES , one year of EUROCRYPT , and 2 NDSS years. Over these years, I have seen good artifacts, even great ones, and a fair share of “just OK” ones. There have been no truly terrible ones, though some required a bit of polish.
